description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

General Dynamics Mission Systems develops high-technology solutions for defense and scientific missions. The Software Engineer will join a cross-functional team in the Space, Embedded, and Intelligence business area to design and develop Crypto and Cross Domain Solutions, with an emphasis on software design, development, and testing.
Junior software engineer developing cryptographic and cross-domain security solutions for space and embedded systems

Responsibilities:
• As a software engineer for Space, Embedded, and Intelligence business area, you’ll be a member of a cross functional team responsible for designing and developing Crypto and Cross Domain Solutions

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, or Engineering, Science, or Math, plus 1 year of relevant experience; or Master's degree
• Ability to obtain a Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire
• Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information
• U.S. citizenship is required
• Clear understanding of the software engineering concepts, principles, theories, software development process, and agile methodology
• Clear understanding of the software development process, with agile experience
• Ability to grasp and apply new information quickly and handle increasing responsibilities with growing complexity
• Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success
• Commitment to ongoing professional development for yourself and others
• Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation
• Linux application development experience
• Experience with SELinux
• Experience with Embedded Linux. VxWorks, RTOS, CDS, ESXi, or YOCTOL
• Experience with Git and GitLab
• Proficient in C/C++, C#, Java, Python, or Rust
• Experience with BASH, sed, awk
• XML Processing (XPath, XSD Schemas etc) (Alpha only)
• Object oriented programming, especially in Java, especially in Java EE
• JavaScript, especially with React
• SQL, especially with PostgreSQL
• Team oriented, personally driven, fast-paced environment

Preferred:
• Software Design, Development, and Testing
